_comment: Chinese message bundle for install.bat/install.ps1. UTF-8 encoded. Loaded only when -Cn switch is set. PS1 file itself stays pure ASCII.
banner_subtitle: 把 setup-anappt 与 analysis-report-builder 安装到 Trae CN 全局技能目录
